title: Morning to 4 pm schedule
assumptions: Class times are confirmed. Morning preparation is estimated at 15 minutes, class transitions at 10 and five minutes, interview travel at 15 minutes, and arrival preparation at 15 minutes. The schedule has no spare time. If travel or meals need longer, use the five-hour fallback or shorten the optional breadth block; preserve core practice, breaks, and arrival time.

rows.title: Morning preparation
rows.task: Prepare breakfast, laptop, and the study environment.

rows.title: Diagnose
rows.task: Attempt the core checks with answers closed.

rows.title: Arrow functions and map
rows.task: Write both callback forms and rebuild a visible list.

rows.title: Break
rows.task: Step away from the screen.

rows.title: Array state and setters
rows.task: Practice immutable append and both valid setter forms.

rows.title: Parent and child callbacks
rows.task: Build the child-to-parent action flow; then pass an object draft.

rows.title: Break
rows.task: Rest, move, and prepare to switch to types.

rows.title: TypeScript part 1
rows.task: Work on inferred state, empty arrays, null, and callback types.

rows.title: Transition to class
rows.task: Estimated 10 minutes. Save a one-sentence next-step note.

rows.title: Math 51
rows.task: Class time; do not count it as study time.

rows.title: TypeScript part 2
rows.task: Resume E08 and explain which types inference supplies.

rows.title: Minimum menu flow
rows.task: Build only the form, parent state, and mapped cards.

rows.title: Lunch and break
rows.task: Use this scheduled break for food and a screen-free pause.

rows.title: Transition to class
rows.task: Estimated five minutes; adjust if the route needs longer.

rows.title: CS106B
rows.task: Class time; leave the practice timer stopped.

rows.title: Core mock interview
rows.task: Run M01 from a blank file, without hints.

rows.title: Targeted repair
rows.task: Score, repair the first broken step, and rebuild with changed data.

rows.title: Break
rows.task: Rest before the final transfer attempt.

rows.title: Optional breadth or core repair
rows.task: Briefly check layout, imports, effects, Promises, and platforms. Use for core repair if needed.

rows.title: Transfer mock interview
rows.task: Run M02 with new data and requirements.

rows.title: Final recall
rows.task: Recall for five minutes, check for two, explain for three.

rows.title: Travel to interview
rows.task: Estimated 15 minutes. Leave earlier if the journey is longer.

rows.title: Arrival preparation
rows.task: Arrive, settle, and check the laptop. No new material.
